_comment: Mutation testing proves the tests are connected to the code. Scoped to TypeScript: Stryker cannot instrument .svelte files, so it targets the actions, constants and icon registry where the logic lives.
_comment_thresholds: break sits just under the achieved score, as a ratchet. a11ySync, deviceMotion, viewTransition and constants are at 100%. The remaining survivors are largely equivalent mutants: layered guards that cover each other (samples.length < 2 vs !first || !last), and boundaries where both branches compute the same value (fraction >= maxDetent adds zero).
